china_race_dynamics.text:
Just minutes before @POTUS announced the 90-day pause on the admin’s reciprocal tariff plan, I questioned @USTradeRep Jamieson Greer on the implications of tariffs on our global advantage in services, our edge in the AI race, and our national security.

I also asked about impacts on our local businesses, such as the Sports Den in SLC, that could potentially never recover from heightened tariffs.

I remain supportive of targeted and aggressive tariffs on our adversaries in strategic sectors, but I share in my constituents’ concerns that the economic realities could harm local business growth, raise prices on working class families, hurt retirement and 529 accounts, and trigger a recession.

I thank Ambassador Greer for his time and will be vigilantly watching what this pause does for our trade landscape.

deepseek.reason: The statement discusses tariffs and AI competitiveness but does not address China race dynamics.
deepseek.confidence_reason: It references the AI race and adversaries but does not explicitly endorse competition with China as a priority.
